name: post-card
description: Article card component for list pages. Renders title, date, and description for each post in a list.

config.usage_note: Called from list.html inside {{ range .Pages }}. Can pass a dict for extra options: partial "post-card.html" (dict "Page" . "ShowDate" true)

css_in_main.note: Add these classes to child theme static/css/main.css to style the card

locked.reason: No JS dependency. All elements are freely changeable.

partials.note: Can freely replace with any card layout
